nodes.title: New-Hire Notification
nodes.sub: Group leader or Scientific Training emails HR that a new employee will start. Initial info often incomplete.

nodes.title: Clarify with Group Leader
nodes.sub: Email back-and-forth until salary, contract length, visa, and basics are complete.

nodes.title: Data complete?
nodes.sub: Loops back to clarification if any base data is missing.

nodes.title: Funding Check
nodes.sub: HR asks Controlling/Grants whether funding is approved; clarifies SAP grant number if applicable.

nodes.title: Funding OK?
nodes.sub: If rejected, the onboarding pauses pending internal clarification.

nodes.title: Entry List
nodes.sub: Central Excel master list. Feeds Welcome Meeting invite, presentation, and several downstream steps.

nodes.title: Send Welcome Mail
nodes.sub: Welcome email to candidate with blank Personal Sheet PDF attached for completion.

nodes.title: Candidate Returns Sheet
nodes.sub: Candidate returns Personal Sheet (sometimes handwritten) plus passport scan.

nodes.title: Clarify with Candidate
nodes.sub: Email loop with candidate until all personal data and contract-relevant info are complete.

nodes.title: KV grading needed?
nodes.sub: Skip classification block if not needed for this position.

nodes.title: onlyfy
nodes.sub: Recruiting tool. Potential source for the candidate CV when not already attached to the trigger email.

nodes.title: Gather Classification Docs
nodes.sub: Pull CV from email or onlyfy; if insufficient, request insurance data extract from candidate.

nodes.title: KV Calculation
nodes.sub: Compute collective-agreement grade and 6th-vacation-week eligibility in the KV workbook (Excel).

nodes.title: Generate Contract Set
nodes.sub: Contract plus Gleitzeit, Home Office and Data Protection Agreement as required by position. Additional Documents if required: Hosting Agreement, Confirmation Letter, Invitation Letter
nodes.undefined:

etc.

nodes.title: Enter 6th-Week into Sage
nodes.sub: Jessica enters the start date for 6th-vacation-week eligibility into the HR system of record.

nodes.title: Sage DPW
nodes.sub: HR system of record. Holds employee master data and entitlements.

nodes.title: Upload to Crush
nodes.sub: Upload contract draft, Entry List + Personal Sheet to Infoniqa Crush. Data lands in LGV.

nodes.title: LGV
nodes.sub: Infoniqa payroll system. Receives the contract draft and Personal Sheet data.

nodes.title: Send Contracts to Candidate
nodes.sub: Send the contract set to the candidate for signature.

nodes.title: Candidate Signs & Returns
nodes.sub: Receive the signed contract back from the candidate.

nodes.title: Print & Prepare Folder
nodes.sub: Print the contract to place it into a physical folder for the director meeting.

nodes.title: Director Signs
nodes.sub: Director signs the printed contract during the regular HR meeting.

nodes.title: Welcome Folder
nodes.sub: Single physical folder per new hire. Check-in sheet pages chosen by institute (GMI/IMBA) and position; signed contract added at the end.

nodes.title: Welcome PowerPoint
nodes.sub: Slide listing new hires (group, position, name) — separate output, not part of the Welcome Folder.

nodes.title: Send Welcome Meeting Invite
nodes.sub: Invite the candidate to the Welcome Meeting using the email from the Eintrittsliste.

nodes.title: Notify Group Leader (Funding)
nodes.sub: Inform the Group Leader that the hiring process has been cancelled because funding is not available.

nodes.title: Midpoint
nodes.sub: Provisions user rights and automatically generates the Welcome Letter containing initial IT access credentials.

nodes.title: Personnel Record (SharePoint)
nodes.sub: Digital repository on SharePoint. Stores the returned signed contract and serves as the official employee record.
